items.title: Bula kar sab to hazrat ne
items.body:
Bula kar sab ko hazrat ne kaha aye karbala waalo
Hame darkaar hai thodi si jaa aye karbala waalo
Iraada hai isi jungle me apna ghar basaae hum
Na ho ta hashr ab tumse juda ae karbala waalo
<<DIVIDER>>
qudara marne waalo ki na roko raah rehne do
Mujhe laayi hai yaa’n meri qaza hai karbala waalo
Rahegi taaba chelhum laash be ghuslo kafan sab ki
Mere naamoos honge berida aye karbala waalo
<<DIVIDER>>
Mai chhup jaaunga gar ek ek mutthi qaak daaloge
Yuhi’n ban jaaega marqad mera aye karbala waalo
Hamari qabr par aana to do aansu baha jaana
Mile fursat to padhna faateha aye karbala waalo
<<DIVIDER>>
Mohib aaye jo baade marg bekas ki ziaarat ko
Bata dena unhe’n mera pata aye karbala waalo
Ajab ghurbat hai apni aisi ghurbat par watan sadqe
Jaha’n paae’n hum apna mud’dua aye karbala waalo
<<DIVIDER>>
Milega chain baade marg bhi mujh ko na turbat me
hilega hashr tak madfan mera aye karbala waalo

items.title: Lutaa hai gulshan-e-Zehra isi Moharram mein
items.body:
Lutaa hai gulshan-e-Zehra isi Moharram mein
Chuttaa hai Sheh sey Madina isi Moharram mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Isi mein Sheh pa huvaa saathveen sey paani bandh
Rahaa Furaath pa pehraa isi Moharram mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Isi mein Aun-o-Mohammad ki laash laaye Shah
Shaheed hogaya dulhaa isi Moharram mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Isi mein qatl huvaa Naujawaan Ali Akbar
Bahaa hai khoon-e-tamanna isi Moharram mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain pyaasey ka baazu isi mein tootaa hai
Shaheed hogaya Saqqaa isi Moharram mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Chiddaa kay teer sey hulqoom Sheh kay haathoun par
Tadap kay rehgayaa bachcha isi Moharram mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Isi mahiney mein sar katt gaya namazi ka
Lahad sey niklee hai Zehra isi Moharram mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Isi mahiney mein masnadh jalee payambar ki
Pidar ko royi Sakina isi Moharram mein
Isi mahiney mein qaidi banay Nabi kay Haram
Chinnee hai chaadar-e-Zehra isi Moharram mein
<<DIVIDER>>
Jigar kharaash hai Shoukath Hussain ki rudaad
Yateem hogayi Sughra isi Moharram mein

items.title: aayi haatif ki aawaz sheh ko
items.body:
Aayi haatif ki aawaz sheh ko utro Shabbir ye karbala hai
Bas qadam ab na aage badhaao utro Shabbir ye karbala hai
Ab safar qatm hai ibne Zahra, labe darya karo qaima barpa
Hashr tak hai yahi’n tumko rehna utro Shabbir ye karbala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Yahi’n nau roz mehmaa’n rahoge, khaane peene ki eeza sahoge
Bhooke pyaase yahi’n qatl honge utro Shabbir ye karbala hai
Marte dam bhi na paani milega, pyaasi gardan pa qanjar chalega
Sar chadega sina pa tumhara utro Shabbir ye karbala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Laash chaalees din tak tumhari, Isi jungle me uryaa’n rahegi
Rone waala bhi hoga na koi utro Shabbir ye karbala hai
Khaaegi jab sakina tamaacha, yahi’n tadpega laasha tumhara
Shimr dega yahi’n usko eeza utro Shabbir ye karbala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Raahwaar apna sarwar ne roka, utre baaqar wahi’n shaahe waala
Haatife ghaib jis dam pukaara utro Shabbir ye karbala hai
